verdict.rationale: Webhook subscriptions are a fair question for a monitoring and incident-management platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The documented alert channels are voice, SMS, email, Slack, Teams and push notifications, plus email subscriptions for status pages. Chat-app integrations and a REST management API do not qualify as webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
